title: Verdict
description: Return value of grade(attempt, task) for every grader (build plan §2). FROZEN interface — edits route through the integrator agent.

pass.description: Grader's accept/reject decision for the attempt.

hack_flags.description: Named hacking patterns the grader detected (e.g. 'test_edit', 'oracle_incompleteness', 'reward_channel', 'hardcoded_output').

tamper_detected.description: Whether the grader detected tampering with tests / grading harness / environment.

footprint_score.description: Region/signal match of the patch footprint against the gold footprint (build plan review note 3). Scored as region/signal overlap, NOT exact-diff equality.
